answer: Each bonded identity posts collateral, but correlated equivocation links identities that sign conflicting messages for the same consensus round. For k coordinated identities, the protocol aggregates evidence and scales penalties as O(k²), rather than treating each signer as an isolated fault. Detection can also trigger an exponential multiplier in capital loss through forfeiture and asymmetric depreciation, making a sybil swarm riskier than honest participation. Like embers spreading across a terrace toward a canyon, one coordinated breach can expose the whole cluster.
